verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 giving "programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources", plus a GraphQL API for Pods, templates and Serverless endpoints. It also offers an S3-compatible API for network volumes and an MCP server and CLI covering Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, registries, models, file transfer and account info, so the core management surface is reachable without the console. However, the claim of "all" covers compute resources rather than an explicit UI-parity guarantee. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence of API coverage for billing/auto-pay/savings-plan and Instant Cluster management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none at standard docs paths), independent or hands-on corroboration.
